verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's own docs describe a 'Start voice chat' option that lets the user talk with the Bot live, so a first-party real-time voice mode exists. The evidence is a single brief mention with no detail on how natural the conversation is, its latency, or its behavior, and no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documentation of voice quality, latency and interruption handling, which platforms support voice (desktop/mobile), and independent or hands-on confirmation that voice conversations feel natural and real-time.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: Choose Start voice chat when the composer is empty to talk with the Bot live.
